key_design_patterns: Every item has its own page with: description, obtaining, usage, recipes, tips, trivia, history
Every building has: category, recipes, power draw, clock speed, ingredients, tips
Every recipe has: ingredients with EXACT RATES, products with EXACT RATES, building, unlock tier
Cross-references everywhere: clicking any ingredient links to its page
Tables with sortable columns for comparing items
Mathematical formulas shown for cost curves (AWESOME Sink coupon costs)
Version history on every page showing what changed per patch

recipe_stats.format: Ingredient1 × count (rate/min) + Ingredient2 × count → Product × count (rate/min) in Building (time)

key_mechanics: Power trip = all stops when consumption > production
Underclocking: 2× machines at 50% = 20% less power than 1× at 100%

awesome_sink.purpose: Destroy items for FICSIT Coupon points

lessons_for_gaia: EVERY entity gets its own page — no cramming everything into one JSON blob
EXACT RATES on everything — not 'sometimes', but '4/min in an Assembler at 100%'
CROSS-REFERENCES — clicking anything leads to its page
PROGRESSION IS VISIBLE — you can see what wave unlocked what
POWER IS REAL — compute draw is measured and graphed
FORMULAS ARE SHOWN — the math behind coupon costs, power curves, clock speed
HISTORY IS TRACKED — what changed in each wave/patch
THE COMMUNITY BUILDS IT — 6,528 pages aren't written by one entity
